name: Texas Eastern Columbia Expansion
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 56: TETCO Columbia Expansion, Texas Eastern Transmission, Expansion, Completed November 1997, PA, 26 mi of new pipe (about 41.8 km), 24 and 36 inch, 142 MMcf/d added, cost 63.1 million dollars (staged 63100000 USD), FERC docket CP96-559. No existing Texas Eastern row (P0235, P0260, P0261, P0262, P2008, P2509, P2562, P5519, P5832, P5835, P7813) matches by name, and P0262 is the whole main line, not this loop. Length passes the 25 km rule. Single source only: the FERC order and a second source were not found because the session hit its usage limit before the search ran. Opening and closing points in Pennsylvania not found; Owner should be re-checked with entity_lookup and entity_style before staging (not run). Single EIA release is one origin, so tier medium. Route not researched. Overlap with the main line row is possible for a 1997 project, so a reviewer should confirm the loop is not already counted in P0262.
